summary.text: Philip Hensley is the Republican candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Gale Adcock (D) and Jonathan Miller (L) are also running.
He was also the Republican candidate for North Carolina House District 11 in 2024, when incumbent Allison Dahle (D) defeated him.
